lead_html: Amara has a minor feel and no half step above the fifth. Start with the first three cards: play each card's lit notes, then move to the next.
alias_html: Also called Celtic, or Celtic Minor.
history_html: D Amara is built from D natural minor with the sixth note left out: D A C D E F G A C. Isthmus Instruments says the names Celtic and Amara are mostly used interchangeably, and that almost every maker has a version of it. It calls the scale intuitive for beginner players. MAG Instruments ties both names to D natural minor and lists them among the most popular handpan scales. Some makers sell it as D Celtic Minor.
progression_tail_html: , top shell only. Try it with the 7 different ways to play chords.
